deliveredSummary: Management aimed for double-digit growth in key verticals for FY27 and margin expansion toward 27%. However, Q1 FY27 Transportation YoY growth stood at 6.7% and EBITDA margins hovered around 21-22%.
bull: Eliminated debt entirely to achieve zero borrowings by Mar 2014 and maintained it through Mar 2015.
Strong cash flow conversion with cumulative CFO to net profit at 168%.
Operating revenue reached INR 1,055.7 crore in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA margin at 21.9%.
bear: Healthcare sector faced severe decline of -13.1% QoQ in constant currency during Q4 FY26.
Transportation growth slowed down to 0.2% QoQ in constant currency during Q4 FY26.
Q1 FY27 Transportation YoY growth of 6.7% tracks behind double-digit target.
business: Tata Elxsi provides design and technology services across Automotive, Media, Communications, and Healthcare. Services span research, strategy, electronics, mechanical design, software development, validation, and deployment.

threads.note: Management maintained double-digit growth targets across calls; Q1 FY27 YoY CC transportation growth came in at 6.7%.
Target maintained at double digits, though Q4 FY26 healthcare growth saw a decline of 13.1% QoQ.
